Robbers Tie Up Family, Steal Gold, Silver, Cash in Faridabad

In Faridabad, Haryana, robbers allegedly tied up the family of a former village head (Sarpanch) and stole approximately 70 tolas of gold, 2.5 kilograms of silver, and cash. The incident occurred at the former Sarpanch's residence. The perpetrators reportedly confined the family members to rooms before fleeing with the valuables. The total value of the stolen items was estimated by one outlet to be around 1.5 crore rupees.
